Kern County Animal Services (KCAS)
3951 Fruitvale Avenue, Bakersfield, CA
Mon–Sat: 10 AM–4 PM | Wed: 2 PM–7 PM

* Adoption fees are always waived for 30-Day Dogs & Cats.
* If you do not live locally, you can adopt over the phone.
* 30 days of complimentary Met Life pet insurance (optional)
* Adoption fees always include Spay/neuter, Microchip,
Vaccinations, and License at no additional cost!
